# hpe_morpheus_cluster_datastore (Resource)

Manages a Morpheus Cluster Datastore resource.




<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `cluster_id` (Number) The ID of the cluster.

### Optional

- `active` (Boolean) Whether the datastore is active.
- `visibility` (String) Visibility for the datastore (private or public).

### Read-Only

- `id` (Number) The ID of the cluster datastore.
- `name` (String) The name of the datastore.
